q: What happens in the free chat?
a: A relaxed 20 to 30 minute video call. You tell us what you'd like to change, we explain how sessions work, and together we decide if it's a good fit. No pressure and no cost.

q: Can you work with my NDIS plan?
a: Yes, if your plan is self-managed or plan-managed. Community Help Co is an unregistered NDIS provider, so we can't be paid from NDIA-managed (agency-managed) plans. If you're not sure how your plan is managed, ask your support coordinator or plan manager, or we can help you check.
No. Mentoring is practical, goal-focused support. It isn't therapy, counselling or medical advice. If you need those, we can help you work out who to contact.
Online, on Microsoft Teams, so you can join from home on a phone, tablet or computer. We work with people across Australia; we're based in Melbourne.

q: How long and how often are sessions?
a: Usually one session a week. We'll agree the length with you during the free chat so it fits your plan and your energy.
After each session you get a short summary: the goals you set, what went well, what got in the way and the next steps. Many people share them with family or their support coordinator.

q: I'm a support coordinator. How do I refer someone?
a: Use the referral form on our contact page, or book a free chat on the participant's behalf. Please don't include health details or NDIS numbers in the form; we'll talk about that privately.
Community Help Co isn't a crisis service. If you or someone else is in danger, call 000. For 24/7 support, call Lifeline on 13 11 14.
